english.title: Fail to permit taking of fingerprint / photograph - subject of violent offender / interim order notification requirement
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the subject of

(A)_[a violent offender order]_
(B)_[an interim violent offender order]_

made by **(..SPECIFY THE COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE..) attended at **(..SPECIFY THE POLICE STATION..), to give an oral notification under section

(C)_[108(1)]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 113(2)(a) and (6) of the Criminal Justice and Immigration Act 2008.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
Section 112(5) of the Criminal Justice and Immigration Act 2008 provides that "local police area", in relation to the offender, means-
(a)the police area in England and Wales in which the home address is situated,
(b)in the absence of a home address in England and Wales, the police area in England and Wales in which the home address last notified is situated, or
(c)in the absence of such a home address and any such notification, the police area in which the court that made the violent offender order (or, as the case may be, the interim violent offender order) is situated.
and "photograph" includes any process by means of which an image may be produced.

other.penalty:
Summary: Imprisonment for a term not exceeding the relevant period and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Five years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit of prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
